As a Business Analyst at Kearney, you will contribute to consulting project teams as they offer honest advice and practical guidance to our clients. Depending on each client’s unique needs, projects can differ in length, size, and location, giving you unique, hands-on experiences across a range of industries and service practices.

Working alongside a dedicated and diverse set of people, you will broaden your knowledge and experience in an open, agile, and collaborative environment. With the freedom to be yourself and recognition for what you bring to the table, you can put your purpose into action and help build a future that works for everyone, everywhere—as a Kearney Original.

Key responsibilities

Ensure the success of projects by completing tasks such as gathering and analyzing data and conducting competitor assessment studies.
Support project workstreams and teams as you work alongside clients from various industries and service practices to create recommendations and implement co-created solutions.
Assist the firm’s business development through generating proposals.
Contribute to the development of thought leadership and other internal and external reports and articles.
Participate in firm building opportunities, e.g. recruiting, training, and mentoring.

Who you are

After nearly 100 years, we know this business is fundamentally about making connections—between facts, figures, insights, strategies, tools, technologies, and above all, people. That’s why we look for collaborative, insightful, and inquisitive problem-solvers who do not accept the first thing in front of them and who are always unapologetically themselves.

We want to hear from you if you are:

Ready to share your ideas and contribute as soon as you join a team
Analytically inclined and enjoy solving problems
Able to prioritize and are a doer by nature
Experienced minimum 1-3 years in in consulting, analytics, finance, or a closely related industry/ role
Fluent in English

What we can offer you

Every day, our people work to be the difference for our clients, our communities, and our colleagues. Helping them make an impact, they are sustained by a competitive remuneration package plus comprehensive benefits and perks, including but not limited to:

Generous retirement/pension savings contribution
Comprehensive medical insurance for employees
Structured and on-the-job learning and development opportunities
Personalized opportunities including talent mobility, flexible work programs, and externships to help you chart a unique career journey to pursue your own personal and professional goals

Read more about our benefits and how you can a make your mark, your way at Kearney.com/careers.

jd_text:
PERL Associate- Consumer

As an Associate at Kearney, you'll help drive the next chapter of our Product Excellence and Renewal Lab (PERLab) — the team helping some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands rethink and reinvigorate their product portfolios for growth.

PERLab sits at a rare intersection: world-class product design fused with Kearney's operational rigor. In partnership with TEAMS Design — renowned for its work in product design, UX, and industrial design — we don't just advise from the outside. We tear products apart, walk the manufacturing line, and rebuild the supply chain from the inside, unlocking margin and efficiency at every stage of the product life cycle.

Our work spans the full arc of a product life — from shaping the category strategy behind a new launch and engineering products that win at scale, to finding the margin hiding in a portfolio and reinventing brands that have lost their edge.

As an Associate, you'll be in the middle of it all — leading workstreams, shaping recommendations that clients act on, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with designers, engineers, and category experts to solve problems that change what actually ends up on shelves.

What you will do

Are you ready to:

Work alongside a dedicated and diverse group of people to offer honest advice and practical guidance to our clients?
Leverage your consumer goods, commercial, or technical background to solve complex consulting challenges?
Work at the intersection of consumer insight, consulting, and design?
Use your knowledge of products, categories, and consumers to create real business impact?
Let your curiosity about what consumers choose—and why—and your passion for solving tough problems sparks new solutions?
Learn and grow by taking advantage of every opportunity available to you?
Join a company that prides itself on its shared values and inclusive culture?
Be the difference and make it happen?

Who You Are

After 100 years, we know this business is fundamentally about making connections—between facts, figures, insights, strategies, tools, technologies, and above all, people. That’s why we look for collaborative, insightful, and inquisitive problem-solvers who don’t accept the first thing in front of them and who are always unapologetically themselves.

A highly analytical problem solver
Curious about what consumers choose, why they choose it, and how products, brands, and categories win in the market
Ready to take ownership of identifying and developing new capabilities that help our clients design stronger product portfolios, accelerate innovation, and drive profitable growth
Bring 5–10 years of relevant professional experience
Have experience in one or more of the following areas: consumer goods, consumer insights, category management, brand or product management, innovation, product development, packaging, R&D, commercial strategy, or supply chain
Hold an MBA or other advanced degree; backgrounds in business, economics, engineering, design, retail, innovation management, supply chain, or related fields are preferred
Are located near, or willing to relocate to, Chicago
Are fluent in English
What we can offer you

Every day, our people work to be the difference for our clients, our communities, and our colleagues. Helping them to make an impact, they are sustained by a competitive remuneration package plus comprehensive benefits and perks, including but not limited to:

Generous retirement/pension saving contributions

Comprehensive medical insurance for employees and their families

Structured and on-the-job learning and development opportunities

Personalized opportunities to help you chart a unique journey to pursue your own personal and professional goals

Compensation and benefits

PERL Associate – Electronics compensation range: $192k-194k

It is important to note that at Kearney, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the top of the range for their role. Individual salaries within each range are determined through a wide variety of factors, including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, and skills. Kearney reviews compensation regularly and may adjust base salaries to reflect market competitiveness. In addition to salary, individuals may be eligible for a discretionary performance bonus. Our full suite of benefits includes paid time off, paid sick leave, 401(k) match and profit sharing, medical, dental, and vision coverage, healthcare concierge services, backup child/adult care, annual employer HSA contributions, a home office stipend, subsidized gym membership, an annual wellness program, and leaves of absence when needed to support employees’ physical, mental, and emotional well-being.

Equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination

Kearney prides itself on providing a culture where our employees belong and thrive equally, which means our people feel comfort, confidence, and joy as they do great things for our firm, our colleagues, and our clients. That’s why Kearney is committed to building a diverse workforce and inclusive environment. Kearney is an equal opportunity employer; we recruit, hire, train, promote, develop, and provide other conditions of employment without regard to a person’s gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race or ethnicity, religion, age, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other differences consistent with applicable laws. This includes providing reasonable accommodation for disabilities or religious beliefs and practices. We encourage everyone to apply, including those who may not feel historically represented in consulting.

Associate

Who are we

As a global consulting partnership in more than 40 countries, our people make us who we are. We’re individuals with different passions and strengths who take as much joy in the work we do as from those we work with. Over the years we’ve fostered a culture in which we are united by shared values—passion, solidarity, generosity, curiosity and boldness—and these come alive in the work we do and how we do it.

Together, we know our people are our difference—for our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. That’s why we take pride in being individual and inclusive and create a place where everyone can bring their full self to work.

Make your mark as an Associate at Kearney

Are you ready to:

Work alongside a dedicated and diverse set of people to offer honest advice and practical guidance to our clients?
Learn and grow by taking advantage of every opportunity available to you?
Join a company which prides itself on its shared values and inclusive culture?
Be the difference and make it happen?

If so, we are ready to help you:

Discover. Collaborating with our clients across a range of industries and service practices, our people are always learning. At Kearney, you will broaden your knowledge and experience across a breadth of areas, no matter your role. Being rooted in expertise, we know our people deserve opportunities to go places and further their exposure to the business world.

Grow. We believe in the power of apprenticeship. At Kearney, you work alongside colleagues who help you be the best you can be. Through both, our structured programs and apprenticeship model, you will continue to learn and develop every day. After all, we are here to help you not just perform, but to thrive in your career.

Be yourself. At Kearney, we give you the freedom to contribute creatively while you also pursue your dreams. We want you to bring your whole self to work and to find joy in what you do. That’s why we support our people when they want to let their uniqueness show and offer personalized opportunities including tuition support, flexible work programs, and externships.

Who you are

If you’re reading this, you’re smart enough to already know what we’re looking for. Insightful, yes. Inquisitive, naturally. Collaborative, of course. But we’re also looking for problem-solvers who think further than that, who don’t accept the first thing in front of them, and who are always unapologetically themselves.

This business is fundamentally about making connections—between facts, figures, insights, strategies, tools, technologies and above all, people. That’s why we expect you to be:

Analytically inclined and love solving problems
Ready to share your ideas and opinions as soon as you join a team
Experienced in your chosen field
In your final year of or hold an MBA degree
Fluent in English

What We Seek

There is no standard model for Kearney associates. We look for talented problem-solvers with intellectual curiosity who are ready to be active members of a client team. Associates are typically involved in every phase of an engagement, from pre-proposal research to final implementation. The following qualifications are preferred:

‒ A proven record of academic excellence

‒ Outstanding written and verbal communication skills

‒ Strong critical thinking and analytical capabilities

‒ An innovative and collaborative approach to problem-solving

‒ Natural self-direction, with the ability to operate in ambiguity and learn quickly

‒ Eagerness to collaborate, coach, mentor, and help others grow professionally

‒ Four to eight years’ success in a rigorous environment, such as a global or Fortune 500 company or consulting firm

To apply please fill in the online form and upload your CV and cover letter. There is no need for any other documents

This position is for the London office only.

Applications will close: Tuesday 27th October 2026

jd_text:
As a Senior Consultant at Oliver Wyman in Stockholm or Copenhagen, you will lead client engagements, structure analyses, and develop recommendations to address complex business challenges. The role involves managing and coaching junior team members, building client relationships, and collaborating across industries. Candidates must have at least 3 years of experience in strategy consulting, an undergraduate or advanced degree in a quantitative discipline, and strong analytical and communication skills. Experience in Banking, Financial Services, Finance, Risk, Restucturing, or Insurance is highly advantageous. Fluency in English and another Scandinavian language, as well as willingness to travel internationally, are required. Preferred qualifications include data analytics, advanced quantitative modelling, CFA or equivalent certification, and an MBA or Master's degree.

Who we are

Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

What you will do

As a Senior Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in shaping client engagements from problem definition through implementation. You will work alongside colleagues of all levels and clients to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.

You’ll help teams understand client strategic challenges while helping develop the next generation of consultants.

You will:

Lead workstreams on client engagements, structuring analyses and developing actionable recommendations that support client decision-making.
Frame hypotheses, identify key business questions, and direct quantitative and qualitative research to generate insights.
Apply structured problem-solving and analytical thinking to solve complex business issues.
Develop high-quality client deliverables, including presentations, analysis, workshops, models, and discussions that help move projects forward.
You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.
You’ll likely have the chance to travel within your home market and internationally. No two weeks are ever the same.
Manage and coach junior team members, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team environment.
Build trusted relationships with clients through clear communication and effective stakeholder management.

Why join us?

You can be your best here

At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

Create solutions that have impact

Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.
Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.
Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

Develop as a leader

Lead workstreams and develop expertise that colleagues and clients seek out.
Mentor junior consultants while continuing to build your own leadership capabilities.
Take ownership of client relationships and increasingly complex engagements.

Learn and grow without limits

Continue developing specialized expertise through challenging projects and formal learning opportunities.
Collaborate with industry specialists and global experts across Oliver Wyman.
Build a sustainable career supported by coaching, mentoring, and continuous professional development.
You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.

Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.
Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.
Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

Experience rewards that work for you

We believe in flexibility, including hybrid working, and in helping colleagues build sustainable careers.
Over time, you’ll have access to opportunities, programs, and experiences designed to help you perform, grow, and thrive — including non-profit fellowships, sabbaticals, and externships. ​
Enjoy competitive local benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and life outside of work.

Who can apply?

We are looking for top-performing professionals who are passionate about solving complex business problems, enjoy developing high-impact content, and are excited to build a long-term career at a leading strategy consulting firm characterized by sustained double-digit growth, an entrepreneurial spirit, and a strong focus on culture and career sustainability.

Required qualifications

3+ years of relevant experience in a top-tier strategy consulting firm.
Experience serving clients within Banking and Financial Services, Finance and Risk, Restucturing, Insurance, Logistic, is highly advantageous.
Undergraduate or advanced degree in STEM, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline from a leading university.
Outstanding analytical and quantitative problem-solving capabilities with the ability to structure ambiguous business problems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across different audiences and seniority levels.
Demonstrated experience working collaboratively in cross-functional, fast-paced environments.
Proven ability to deliver results under pressure while managing multiple priorities.
Fluent business English and another Scandinavian language
Willingness to travel internationally as client needs require.

Nice to have

Data analytics, advanced quantitative modelling, or data science capabilities.
CFA or equivalent professional certification.
MBA or Master's degree from a top-tier university.

What we're looking for?

Successful candidates demonstrate:

Intellectual curiosity and structured problem solving.
Strong ownership and accountability.
Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
An inclusive leadership style and commitment to developing others.
Adaptability, resilience, and entrepreneurial thinking.
A collaborative mindset with the ability to work respectfully across diverse teams and cultures.

How to apply? ​

Please submit your CV, cover letter, and academic transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website.

What to expect during the interviews process?

At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

With a mix of conversational and case interviews, our approach not only helps us to get to know you better, understanding your strengths and interests, but it also enables you to learn more about our people and our business..

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

The Oliver Wyman DNA is a distinguished center of excellence for business analytics and data analytics within Oliver Wyman. Solid understanding of financial modeling concepts, valuation techniques, and analytical frameworks.

High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and ability to work collaboratively in fast-paced environments.

The salary range is $190,000 to $240,000, with eligibility for performance-based incentives and a comprehensive benefits package.

Who We Are?

Oliver Wyman is a global leader in management consulting. With offices in 60 cities across 29 countries, Oliver Wyman combines deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise in strategy, operations, risk management, and organization transformation. The firm has more than 6,000 professionals around the world who work with clients to optimize their business, improve their operations and risk profile, and accelerate their organizational performance to seize the most attractive opportunities. Oliver Wyman is a wholly owned subsidiary of Marsh & McLennan Companies [NYSE: MMC]. For more information, visit www.oliverwyman.com.

Job Specification

Practice Group: Financial Services

Practice: Insurance

Location: New York

Role: Associate, Engagement Manager

Practice Overview

The Insurance and Asset Management Practice provides leading Life Insurers, Property & Casualty Insurers, and Asset Managers with strategic insights to succeed in a rapidly evolving competitive, regulatory, and capital markets environment. Our work spans a range of topics, including strategy development, financial effectiveness, product design and management, operational excellence, underwriting and pricing, and distribution. Recent examples of our impact include:

Establishing a Greenfield insurer from strategy formulation, technology selection across the value chain, project planning through to implementation
Designing a multi-year corporate strategy for an Independent Broker Dealer that included product development, distribution and operations and technology components
Building a generative-AI powered contract review tool reviewing the insurance sections of contracts

Developing a target operating model for the Finance and Actuarial functions of a life insurer to empower them with enhanced data and the technology they need to design products, perform pricing updates, and calculate reserves

The Insurance Practice is seeking Associates and Engagement Managers to support our continued expansion, a strategic priority for the firm. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a successful team. For more information about our Practice, please visit https://www.oliverwyman.com/our-expertise/industries/financial-services/insurance-and-asset-management.html

Associate / Engagement Manager Role

Our consulting roles offer excellent career and growth opportunities for talented, highly motivated professionals with relevant prior experience. As a professional member of our firm in the Associate or Engagement Manager role, your initial responsibilities will include:

Managing the execution of individual project workstreams or projects. This typically includes project / workstream planning and coordination; developing hypotheses; managing data collection, model creation and analyses; conducting primary and secondary research; creatively tackling information limitations; and surfacing insights
Synthesizing findings into written presentations; reviewing and discussing with clients and other stakeholders; leading client readouts of written presentations or deliverables
Supporting our Partner group in project delivery through accurate and high-quality execution

Managing and developing junior consultants on individual project workstreams or projects. This typically includes task allocation tailored appropriately by skill sets; output / deliverable review and iteration; constructive feedback sessions; and mentoring / development in consulting skillset and / or insurance industry content or related topics

Just as every client project is different, we recognize and value the diversity of backgrounds and skill sets for successful candidates. We are seeking high-caliber individuals who want to join our winning team. While specific responsibilities will vary based on previous experience the ideal candidate will have the following:

4-7 years of relevant experience, ideally with a top-tier strategy consulting firm (or other similar organizations with project-based, team-oriented environments)

jd_text:
Do you enjoy shaping strategy and leading complex strategic projects?
Are you curious and able to translate client needs into impactful solutions?
Do you thrive as a team player in a highly collaborative organization?
To further strengthen our Amsterdam office, we are hiring a Senior Consultant / Project Manager. So, if you can answer yes to the questions above then keep reading!

The Roland Berger Amsterdam DNA
Roland Berger is a global strategy consulting firm that assists clients to grow and adapt to the challenges of today. Founded in 1967 in Munich, we are one of the leading representatives of our industry, with more than 50 offices and 3,500 dedicated colleagues around the world.
Our young, dynamic and fast-growing office in Netherlands employs 120 consultants and supporting colleagues. We are proud of the close-knit culture within our Amsterdam office. We are creative, dedicated, ambitious, entrepreneurial and passionate - and at the same time social, energetic, open-minded and respectful. We help each other to bring out the best in each other and the best for our clients. Besides our client work, we foster our office culture through many social activities together, from sports and drinks to office trips and celebrations of holidays.
What we offer
Your success is our success. We offer plenty of opportunities for development, (inter)national training courses and a mentor to support your development. In addition, we offer excellent benefits, including 30 days of vacation, transportation benefits, a non-contributory pension and a contribution to your health insurance.
What you will be doing
You will contribute to high-impact projects shaping the future of the chemical industry and its adjacent sectors. As chemistry is a critical enabler of industries ranging from automotive and construction to electronics and pharmaceuticals, you will not only address the challenges of the transition of the chemical industry, but create impact far beyond in both upstream and downsteam value chains. For example, the transition of the industry goes hand-in-hand with the energy and water transitions being equally intertwined with these challenges, and creating a wide range of questions that cut across industries and expertise.
You will work in (international) teams and collaborate closely with clients on core topics such as decarbonization, circularity, resilience & competitiveness and innovation. You will tackle complex questions at the intersection of strategy, M&A, operations, technology and innovation, from redefining strategies and portfolios and responding to changing customer needs and regulation, to transforming operations, developing new business models and driving innovation.
You will be at the forefront of an industry in transition, helping companies navigate uncertainty, solve complex challenges and build the future.
As a Senior Consultant / Project Manager at Roland Berger you will:

- Take the lead for modules in larger projects, and complete project management of smaller projects (typically leading three to five consultants).
- Coach and develop the consultants in your project teams.
- Have direct client contact and lead presentations during client meetings.
- Work closely with industry experts at Roland Berger.
- Contribute to Roland Berger’s knowledge development by capturing insights and drawing lessons from client work.
- Participate in office-wide projects (e.g. in-depth studies on current topics) that further develop Roland Berger or its thinking in a specific area or sector.

Who we seek
At Roland Berger we are looking for people who are genuinely interested in our clients and their challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work hard to deliver the highest quality. The values of “empathy”, “entrepreneurship” and “excellence” are the foundation of our work and our culture. We are looking for people who recognize themselves in these values, who can think big, dare to dream, see connections and make connections, are self-starters and can enrich our team.
Our requirements

- You have completed an academic university education (i.e. WO).
- You have between two and six years of experience in strategy and/or management consulting, and/or in strategic/business development and/or business roles at a large company.
- You have prior experience in the chemical industry or a closely adjacent industrial sector. Experience with areas such as specialty chemicals, ingredients, plastics, minerals, energy, water is relevant.

Healthy work-life balance
The right work-life balance is critical to performing at such a high level. We understand that this balance differs per person and life phase. Your mentor will help you to organize your work in a way that suits you and your goals.
Diversity
We believe that a team of unique professionals with a diversity of backgrounds and qualities brings out the best in each other and provides the best results for our clients. Our international character makes us very diverse as a firm; this is something we strive for in our office as well. We are looking for people who can and want to contribute to the office with their unique perspective and qualities.
Keen to apply?
Upload your resume with a motivation letter and grade lists (of high school, bachelor and master).
The application process starts with a review of your application documents, followed by assessment round consisting of a personality test and an analytical assessment. The personality test is completed individually and before the analytical assessment. The analytical assessment is completed via MS Teams and is selective. When the analytical assessment is completed successfully the next phase is the first round interviews, three interviews: one interpersonal interview and two case interviews. In the final phase, you will have two additional interviews and must present a case.
Our research shows that female candidates only apply when they meet 100% of the requirements while male candidates apply when they meet only 60%. So, if you recognize yourself in this role and meet at least some of the requirements, do not hesitate to contact us. We look forward to receiving your application!
Do you have questions? Then get in touch with Maxime Jansen (Senior Recruiter) at maxime.jansen@rolandberger.com. We would be happy to hear from you!

Rejoignez la Business Unit Human Resources & Transformation , spécialisée dans l’évolution des organisations et politiques RH.
En tant que Consultant·e Senior Rewards , vous interviendrez directement auprès de nos clients (CAC 40, SBF 120, ETI/PME) sur les thématiques suivantes :
Référentiel des emplois et classification

- Construire ou ajuster le référentiel des emplois.

- Identifier la méthode de classification adaptée au besoin client (méthode conventionnel, méthode de cabinet…).

- Animer des ateliers de cotation des emplois et garantir la cohérence globale des résultats.

- Appuyer la présentation des résultats aux différentes instances projet (DRH, DG, CODIR…).

- Former les équipes RH.
Politique de rémunération

- Concevoir des fourchettes de rémunération et la formalisation d’une politique de rémunération en accord avec les objectifs stratégiques de l’entreprise.

- Structurer et/ou optimiser les processus de rémunération : campagnes salariales, mobilité, promotions, performance management.
Accompagnement à la mise en conformité

- Accompagner les entreprises dans leur mise en conformité : cadrage, diagnostic, recommandations, plans d’action.

- Adapter les processus RH impactés (recrutement, promotion, mobilité, classification, performance).

- Renforcer le dialogue social (dossiers d’information/consultation, communication managériale, animation de commission avec les partenaires sociaux supports d’acculturation) et appuyer la conduite du changement.

jd_text:
Rejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques.
Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert·es passionné·es et orienté·es solutions, qui placent l’humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Ambitieux·ses et en pleine expansion, nous développons sans cesse notre portefeuille de clients et de projets, avec une portée internationale et une réelle volonté de générer un impact positif.
Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain.

Description de la Business Unit TIME
TIME (Transport, Infrastructure, Manufacturing, Energy) accompagne les leaders industriels et énergétiques dans leur digitalisation.
Nous soutenons leurs projets de transformation des systèmes d’information, de la définition de la stratégie IT au choix et au déploiement des solutions (ERP, EPM, TMS, WMS, CRM…), ainsi que la transformation des métiers tout au long de la chaîne de valeur (R&D, Production, Supply, Vente, Marketing).
Nous accélérons également l’adoption des technologies digitales en aidant nos clients à valoriser leurs données et à industrialiser l’innovation, notamment via l’IoT, la GenAI et les jumeaux numériques.
Notre accompagnement repose sur des expertises sectorielles, fonctionnelles et technologiques, continuellement renforcées par la veille et la formation.
Description du poste
Encadré par des consultants expérimentés, vous interviendrez dans des projets variés chez nos clients de ces différents secteurs, et notamment dans les domaines suivants :

- Innovation / R&D : accompagner la stratégie, l’organisation et la transformation des filières de recherche & innovation. Contribuer au financement de l’innovation par les leviers de subvention publique.
- Conception / Ingénierie : améliorer le développement et maîtriser le cycle de vie des produits et services par l’efficacité des processus et la digitalisation.
- Excellence industrielle : améliorer la performance des opérations (Industrie 4.0.) et repositionner la production comme maillon essentiel dans le pilotage de l'entreprise, optimiser la gestion des actifs et de la maintenance, accompagner la réalisation des schémas directeurs industriels (projection de performance, capacité, implantations, roadmaps de mise en œuvre…).
- Expérience client : transformer les offres et l'expérience client B2C & B2B de nos clients : optimisation des parcours, digitalisation de l’expérience client, développement de nouveaux services, performance des forces de vente.
- Finance et performance : améliorer l'analyse de la performance et les prévisions, renforcer le contrôle des risques, adopter des modèles opérationnels plus globaux. Les opportunités offertes par le digital (IoT, Data, Intelligence artificielle…) permettent d'opérer une transformation en profondeur de ces secteurs, tant au niveau de leurs processus que de leurs outils. Vous pourrez ainsi :

- Explorer puis maîtriser en profondeur les enjeux de ces secteurs au cœur de la transformation de nos clients.
- Monter en compétence sur le digital.
- Appréhender toutes les étapes de mise en œuvre des projets : cadrage et stratégie, organisation de la gouvernance, business model, business plan, Product Management, gestion de projet, conduite du changement…
- Développer les compétences clés d'un consultant : formalisation, prise de recul, restitution, relation client, encadrement, partage de conviction, développement commercial…). En parallèle de votre participation à une ou plusieurs missions, un sujet interne pourra vous être confié durant votre CDI, sur une thématique prospective et/ou innovante sur laquelle Wavestone et la business unit Transport, Infrastructure, Manufacturing & Energy en particulier souhaitent développer leur expertise.

Diplômé(e) d'une grande école d'ingénieurs, de management ou grande université, vous justifiez idéalement d'une expérience acquise dans un cabinet de conseil ou dans le secteur de l'énergie ou des utilities.

Votre curiosité intellectuelle, vous permet de comprendre rapidement les spécificités de nos clients. Vous êtes doté(e) d'un esprit critique et analytique aiguisé, d'un très bon relationnel et d'un sens prononcé du service et de l'excellence. Vous souhaitez intégrer des équipes à taille humaine favorisant la proximité et la transmission des savoirs. Vous recherchez un environnement de travail stimulant, propice à l'épanouissement personnel au sein d'un cabinet de conseil reconnu et en pleine croissance.

Si votre objectif est d'être acteur d'un projet d'entreprise ambitieux et de mettre à profit votre talent et votre enthousiasme dans une société qui saura vous proposer une trajectoire dynamique et des prises de responsabilités rapide, donnez-vous les chances de rejoindre nos équipes !

Tous nos métiers sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap

Wavestone est un employeur inclusif qui s'engage pour l'égalité des chances. Dans le cadre de cette politique de diversité et inclusion, Wavestone accompagne les personnes en situation de handicap et/ou nécessitant un aménagement durant leur process de recrutement et lors de leur prise de poste.

Du analysierst und interpretierst quantitative und qualitative Daten, um Marktpotenziale zu identifizieren und konkrete, umsetzbare Empfehlungen abzuleiten – insbesondere im Kontext digitaler Geschäftsmodelle und KI-basierter Lösungen für kommerzielle Produktteams.
Die Erstellung von überzeugenden Präsentationen und Management-Reports für unsere Kunden sowie die strukturierte Aufbereitung von Analysen, Erkenntnissen und Empfehlungen zählen ebenfalls zu deinen Aufgaben.
Du nimmst an Workshops und Trainings teil, entwickelst deine Beratungs- und Business-Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiter und vertiefst dein Verständnis unserer Commercial Strategy-Methodik sowie digitaler und KI-getriebener Ansätze.
Du arbeitest in funktionsübergreifenden, internationalen Teams und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Expertise zusammen, um komplexe kommerzielle Fragestellungen in der Pharma- und Biotech-Industrie zu lösen.
Hiermit begeisterst du:

Du verfügst über zwei bis vier Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich Commercial Strategy in einer Strategieberatung oder in der Industrie und konntest dabei bereits praktische Erfahrung mit digitalen Themen und dem Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz sammeln.
Ein fundiertes Verständnis von Kommerzialisierungsmodellen in der Pharma- und Biotech-Industrie, regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen sowie Marktdynamiken in zentralen globalen Märkten ermöglicht es dir, dich sicher in diesem Branchenumfeld zu bewegen.
Du hast bereits mit digitalen Tools und KI Marketing- und Sales-Strategien datenbasiert weiterentwickelt und dabei aktiv an der Konzeption und Umsetzung zukunftsorientierter, KI-gestützter Marken- und Vertriebsmodelle mitgewirkt.
Mit einer proaktiven, hands-on Mentalität treibst du Innovationen und Wachstum voran – sowohl eigenständig als auch im Team – und bewegst dich souverän in einem dynamischen Beratungsumfeld.
Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kannst fließende Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse vorweisen.

jd_text:
Deine Aufgaben
Wir bauen unser Organizational & Agile Transformation Team weiter aus und suchen dafür Dich als Consultant Agile Organisation am Standort Deiner Wahl.
Du kannst dich auf spannende Projekte mit den Schwerpunkten agile Transformation, Organisationswandel und Coaching von Management und Teams in skalierbaren agilen Frameworks freuen. In einem Umfeld, das die Vorzüge einer familiären, persönlichen Kultur mit der Stärke einer führenden Managementberatung vereint.

- Du coachst und führst unsere Kunden und explizit deren Management im Aufbau eines agilen Mindsets

- Du begleitest aktiv den Wandel zu einer agilen Organisation als Teil eines agilen Transformationsteam

- Du etablierst und entwickelst agile Methoden zur Neugestaltung der Arbeits- und Denkweisen in einer lernenden Organisation mit offener Fehlerkultur

- Du zeigst Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und Karriereperspektiven innerhalb der agilen Organisation auf inkl. Einführung von Teamzielen und Incentivierungsmodellen in der crossfunktionalen Zusammenarbeit

- Du baust individuelle skalierte Projektorganisationen mit mehreren agilen Teams auf (z.B. basierend auf SAFe, Spotify, LeSS)

- Du erhältst Coachings zum Scrum Master, Product Manager, Release Train Engineer oder vergleichbaren agilen Rollen

- Du identifizierst neue Businessmöglichkeiten und baust ein Netzwerk auf

Dein Profil

- Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium, eventuell mit einer Zusatzqualifikation.
- Darüber hinaus bringst du nachweisliche Berufserfahrung als Scrum Master:in, Agile Coach oder in einer vergleichbaren Position in einem agilen Umfeld mit – bevorzugt im Beratungsumfeld.
- Mit deinem ausgeprägten agilen Mindset begeisterst und motivierst du die Menschen in Deinem Umfeld.
- Im Umgang mit dem Management unserer Kund:innen trittst du souverän auf und verfügst über erste Erfahrungen in der Transformation von Organisationen.
- Außerdem zeichnest du Dich durch hohe Umsetzungsstärke und Eigenmotivation aus.
- Auch in herausfordernden Situationen behältst du den Überblick und verlierst dabei weder Gelassenheit noch Humor.
- Du bringst erste praktische Erfahrungen im Umgang mit GenAI (z. B. Copilot, ChatGPT) mit.
- Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und bringst die notwendige Reisebereitschaft als Berater:in mit. Zusätzliche Pluspunkte

- Wertvoll ist es, wenn du in folgenden Punkten Erfahrung gesammelt hast: in der Erstellung von Kundenangeboten, im Account Management sowie im Business Development.
- Ebenso hilfreich ist Praxiserfahrung in der Begleitung mehrerer agiler Teams, etwa als Coach, Guide oder Organisationsentwickler:in.
- Darüber hinaus sind einschlägige Zertifizierungen wie etwa systemische:r Coach, LeSS Practitioner, Scrum Master:in, SAFe oder Scrum@Scale von Vorteil.

Deine Benefits

- Your career, your way: Unser Personal Growth Model und Coaching & Leading-Ansatz bieten Dir eine enge, vollumfängliche Unterstützung sowohl in Deiner langfristigen Entwicklung als auch im Daily Business. In unserer Academy findest Du ein breites Angebot an Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungskursen, mit umfassendem AI Upskilling durch DataCamp und interne Initiativen, sowie individuellem Coaching. Und durch unser flexibles Karrieremodell sowie unseren Fluid Company Ansatz entscheidest Du selbst, wo und wie schnell es für Dich weiter geht.
- Karriere & Privatleben: Dank Mobile Work Policy arbeitest Du bequem von zuhause oder in einem unserer Büros in Deutschland. Mit „Mobile Work Abroad“ kannst Du bis zu 50 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland (sowie UK, NOR, ISL, LIE, CHE) arbeiten. Des Weiteren gibt es 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, weitere Urlaubstage bei besonderen familiären Umständen sowie verschiedene Sabbatical-Optionen.
- Mobilität nach Maß: Dank eines festen monatlichen Mobilitätsbudgets bist Du bei uns flexibel und umweltbewusst unterwegs: egal, ob privat oder beruflich, und mit einem klaren Fokus auf nachhaltige Verkehrsmittel.
- Wert-volle Unternehmenskultur: Unsere Werte verantwortungsbewusst,energiegeladen und gemeinsam sind zentrale Bestandteile unseres Alltags. Das spürst Du z. B. bei unseren Powerdays (bei denen Du Dich gemeinnützig engagieren kannst), in unseren Netzwerken (wie dem Women’s Network), durch unsere regelmäßigen Mitarbeiterbefragungen über Great Place To Work, bei unseren Firmenevents, internen Fitnessgruppen, unserem Corporate Benefit Programm und vielem mehr.
- Vergütung & monetäre Vergünstigungen: Wir bieten faire und attraktive Gehälter, bestehend aus einem fixen und einem leistungsbasierten Anteil. Zudem gleichen wir unsere Gehälter regelmäßig über externe Benchmark Studien mit dem Markt ab – immer auch mit Blick auf Gender Equal Pay. Darüber hinaus erhältst Du monetäre Vergünstigungen im Rahmen des EGYM Wellpass, exklusiver Corporate Shopping-Rabatte sowie unseres Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOP), in welchem Du Wavestone-Aktionär:in werden kannst.
